meta.name: skill-builder
meta.description: Automatically detect source types and build AI skills using Skill Seekers. Use when the user wants to create skills from documentation, repos, PDFs, videos, or other knowledge sources.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 从文档、代码、视频等来源自动构建AI技能
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果想从各种来源快速生成AI技能
copy.tagline_en: Auto-build AI skills from documentation, repos, videos, and more
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you want to quickly generate AI skills from diverse knowledge sources

howto.what: 装上后，Claude能识别你给的链接或文件类型，自动抓取内容，再帮你打包成一个AI可以直接用的技能包。
howto.when: 当你给出文档网址、GitHub仓库、PDF文件或视频链接，并希望做成AI技能时触发。

say.text: 把这个文档网站做成AI技能。
say.note: 自动检测来源并开始抓取。

say.text: 帮我从这个GitHub仓库创建技能。
抓取这个PDF文件，生成技能包。

howto.what_en: Claude automatically detects the source type (URL, GitHub, PDF, video, etc.) and scrapes, processes, and packages it into an AI-ready skill.
howto.when_en: Triggers when the user provides a documentation URL, GitHub repo, PDF, video, or similar source and asks to create an AI skill.

say_en.text: Turn this documentation site into an AI skill.
Create a skill from this GitHub repository.
say_en.note: Scrapes repo content and packages it.

say_en.text: Scrape this PDF and generate a skill package.
say_en.note: Extracts PDF content and encapsulates it.
